facts.text: The hotel is in West Bay, within Doha's financial and diplomatic districts.
facts.excerpt: Conveniently situated within the financial and diplomatic districts, our hotel is located in West Bay.

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of City Center Doha and The Gate Mall.
facts.excerpt: It's within walking distance from City Center Doha and The Gate Mall, and convenient to the DECC and Metro Station.

facts.text: The hotel occupies a 58-story tower.
facts.excerpt: Our 58-story landmark offers sweeping views of the Doha skyline, the Arabian Gulf, and the city streets below.

facts.text: The tower has views of the Doha skyline, the Arabian Gulf and the city streets below.
facts.excerpt: Our 58-story landmark offers sweeping views of the Doha skyline, the Arabian Gulf, and the city streets below.

facts.text: An open-air pool on the 46th floor looks out over Doha's skyline.

facts.text: The 46th-floor Health and Fitness Club has cardio machines, free weight zones and a shaded rooftop pool.
facts.excerpt: Perched high on the 46th floor, experience unparalleled luxury with state-of-the-art cardiovascular machines, expansive free weight zones, and a tranquil rooftop shaded pool.

facts.text: Lamara Spa is on the 46th floor.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to Lamara Spa, a serene retreat on the 46th floor of InterContinental Doha The City.

facts.text: Lamara Spa has a sauna and steam temple and a hammam suite.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in our four treatment rooms, Sauna & Steam temple, and luxurious Hammam suite.

facts.text: All rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with city views.

facts.text: La Vista, on the 55th floor, is a nightlife venue with skyline views.

facts.text: The Curry House pairs Indian flavors with modern design.
facts.excerpt: Dive into The Curry House, where authentic Indian flavors meet modern design in Doha.
